meta.title: 🇻🇳 സ്വപ്ന യാത്രയുടെ തുടക്കം | Kochi to Hanoi | Vietnam #01
meta.description:
Vietnam #01 - This is the first episode of our 3-week Vietnam journey! We began our adventure from Kochi and landed in Hanoi, where we had a layover at Don Mueang Airport in Thailand. From Hanoi Airport, we took a cab to the vibrant Old Quarter and checked into our hotel. In this episode, we explore Hanoi’s iconic traditional Pho and the famous Vietnamese egg coffee. We’ve also included a step-by-step guide on how to get a Vietnam visa.

@malludronetraveller with @GDstories 

Chapters
00:00 Introduction
00:48 Check-in process - Cochin Airport
02:37 Tasting Vietnamese coffee
03:30 Hanoi airport to Old Quarter
07:35 Tasing Vietnamese Pho
12:05 Tasing Vietnamese Egg Coffee
14:37 Hanoi Night walk
16:05 How to get a Vietnam visa?
